description: NaMgNiO₆I crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.47 Å. Mg is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.61 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent IO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.16 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.91 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.92 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.94 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.89 Å. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.93 Å. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to one Mg, one Ni, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.89 Å. I is bonded to six O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share edges with three equivalent NiO₆ octahedra.
